concept: Organizations: consolidated billing and shared RI/Savings Plans discounts
tests: Which feature consolidates account bills and shares volume discounts and RI benefits.
expected: AWS Organizations consolidated billing — one payer account, aggregated volume tiers, shared RI/Savings Plans. Triggers: "consolidated bill", "share volume discounts and Reserved Instance benefits".
why_not: Separate bills — no aggregation; tagging — cost allocation only; Budgets in each account — alerts, not bill consolidation.
